data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'andros' meaning 'man' or 'mankind'. In Christian tradition, the name Andros is associated with the androgynous figure of Jesus, who embodies both the masculine and feminine aspects of God. The name Andros carries the meaning “Man, mankind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Andros usually hope their child will grow to embody man, mankind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
